items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), a critical template engine injection flaw with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allows unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. It also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution (CVE-2026-92909) and several stored cross-site scripting issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | CVE-2026-75650 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix addresses CVE-2026-75650, a critical template engine injection vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allows unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and several incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) and stored cross-site scripting flaws. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | CVE-2026-48356 (PolyShell)
items.summary: This bulletin fixes CVE-2026-48356 (PolyShell), a critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.6/9.3 that could lead to arbitrary code execution. CISA has added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, indicating active exploitation.

items.title: CosmicSting: XML external entity injection in REST API
items.summary: This vulnerability, publicly known as CosmicSting, allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files like `env.php` via XML external entity injection in the REST API. When chained with the glibc iconv bug CVE-2024-2961, it can lead to arbitrary code execution, with mass exploitation observed in September 2026.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Discovered in August 2025, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Mass attacks exploiting SessionReaper were observed starting October 22, 2025.
